notes: Shaded rendering of real LRO NAC DTM elevation (not a photo). Crop is a 2.4km square placed to minimize nodata while containing the DTM's highest well-supported pixel (>=60m from any stereo-correlation gap), resampled to 1024x1024. Spawn is the lowest-slope point within 300-1000m of the summit. mask.bin marks nodata-filled cells (rendered as a hatched no-data texture in albedo.jpg/preview.png); spawn and goal are kept >= 20px clear of them. spawn relocated from (65,628) to (214,633) -- original was within 20px of a nodata-filled cell; picked the lowest-slope real-data cell satisfying the clearance instead. PATCHED by tools/patch_playability_sites.py: spawn relocated from (214,633) to (212,856): the original spawn was in a real-terrain pocket isolated (under the copilot default 25deg slope guardrail, smoothed rover-scale slope) from every other reachable cell, including the goal. (212,856) is a real, mask-clear, low point with a confirmed A*-reachable route to the unchanged summit goal (128,793). PATCHED by tools/patch_playability_sites.py: spawn relocated from (214,633) to (158,866): the original spawn was in a real-terrain pocket isolated from every other reachable cell under a realistic slope threshold. (158,866) is a real, mask-clear, low point (elev -1145m) with a generous local safety margin and a dilated-safe (no knife-edge pinches) route to the relocated goal. PATCHED by tools/patch_playability_sites.py: goal relocated from (128,793) to (114,792): the original summit goal is reachable in principle, but every route from a safe spawn threads a genuine knife-edge terrain pinch that a delayed-telemetry controller cannot reliably clear. (114,792) is the highest point (elev -990.0m, 8m below the original -982.0m - functionally the same peak) reachable via a route with a real safety buffer around every step, verified by a headless bot in tests/playability.test.mjs.
maskMeaning: 1 = no orbital data (filled), treat as impassable
